ppc.def: A production possibilities curve: a graph of every combination of two goods a producer can make when it uses all its resources efficiently with its current methods.

productive-efficiency.def: Making the most output possible from the resources available: any point on the PPC; a point inside it is inefficient.

increasing-cost.def: Increasing opportunity cost means each extra unit of a good costs more of the other good, which bows the PPC out; constant cost gives a straight line and decreasing cost bows it in.

economic-growth.def: An increase in the most a producer or an economy can make, shown by an outward shift of the PPC, from more or better resources or better technology.
